name: Buckeye Recreation Area (Pioneer Campground)
evidence: rec.gov 234724 per-site 'Lakefront' on standard RV sites 02,03,05,07,08,11,13,14 (spurs 35-74 ft); plotted GPS on satellite puts 05, 07 ~10-20 m from pale beach/high-water edge; official photos of 02,03,05,07,11,13,14 show pad, rail fence, narrow grass, then reservoir bed, no road between. North shore, not below dam.

name: Cataract Creek Campground
evidence: Satellite at 39.83879,-106.30699: spur ends at conifer edge, not the sage bench of the prior point (39.8380,-106.3150). Lower Cataract Lake ~950 m SW behind trees and a rise; Green Mountain Reservoir 2.3 km+. NHD creek line 110-150 m+ from spur. FS page claims no water view; no rec.gov photos.

name: Cayton Campground
evidence: rec.gov 233250 tags all Loop A sites 'Riverfront' (RV spurs 30-70 ft; Loop B none). Leaf-on NAIP + NHD overlay: top-row Loop A pads ~15-20 m from the Dolores channel through a thin conifer band, narrower than the 35-45 m lead; imagery does not contradict. Site photos show no water.

name: Cement Creek Campground
evidence: Leaf-on NAIP + NHD: Loop 1 pad with parked RV ~20-35 m from creek lines at the confluence, water under canopy, so creekside not earned. Campendium 2023-06-27: Loop 1 sites 2-4 'in view of the river with river access'; Loop 2 (6-13) cars/vans only. No rec.gov per-site data or photos. Held at riverview on that report.

name: Cimarrona Campground
evidence: Plotted rec.gov site GPS: sites in trees/meadow edge, Cimarrona Creek 150-250 m out across meadow. Williams Reservoir's north tip ~2.2 km S, DEM 2560 m vs 2511 m. Official photos (01,02,03,06,11,13, Standard; others have none) show no reservoir. FS 'views of Williams Reservoir' and visitor quote are prose only.

name: Cottonwood Lake Campground
evidence: Satellite frames at 38.7825,-106.2935 and -106.2880: loops on aspen hillside ~500 m from inlet pond, ~600 m+ from open lake, CR 344 and willow marsh between; DEM ~14 m above lake. FS: 'within walking distance' only; rec.gov no site photos. One Campendium review (2018, site 23) reports a lake view: unofficial, not enough. Prior point was in the marsh.

name: Comstock Campground
evidence: Leaf-on NAIP + NHD at 37.4452,-106.3622: loop now legible; north pads ~20-35 m from South Fork Rock Creek through dense green band (channel sits north of the NHD line per winter frame). Unnamed NHD line across loop unconfirmed. Not clearly inside the bound; rec.gov 10405299 has no per-site data or photos, FS gives no shoreline claim. Defaults down.

name: Cochetopa Creek Rec Site
evidence: Satellite at 38.3070,-106.7635 (.27 m/px): RV parked on a spur ~13-20 m from a visible creek bend across a willow fringe; a second RV and turnaround sit ~50-70 m out. BLM page: 'developed campsites and picnic areas located along the creek'. No per-site list; BLM photos show no sites.
